description: This Java class implements the CommandStrategy interface to handle the disbursement of loans within the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests to disburse loans by calling the LoansApiResource and manages the response accordingly.

classes.name: DisburseLoanCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to disburse loans in batch requests by invoking the LoansApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles a batch request to disburse a loan by parsing the request URL, calling the LoansApiResource, and preparing the BatchResponse.
